prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity portrait Android app UI composition for Earth Online v2, option 3 of a three-comp approval round
Input images: Image 1 is a style and identity reference only. Carry over its Earth mother-brand, dark jade palette, modern Chinese type character, black lacquer, rare gold foil, cinnabar breach marks, orbital etching, and finish quality. Do not copy its central hero-card-plus-vertical-track composition or task-list topology.
Primary request: Design a materially different "上下分舱" composition for the same Android quest dashboard. Separate consequence from action: the upper status chamber explains realm, current cultivation, cultivation debt, and why it matters; the lower Android task drawer makes one Next Quest and today's contracts immediately actionable.
Composition/framing: exact portrait phone viewport, 1080x2400 feeling, no phone hardware. Compact system-safe top app bar with Earth Online and a real two-option narrative system switcher. Upper 40% is one continuous black-lacquer status chamber, not cards: an enormous "Lv.23" and "金丹境" left aligned, a horizontal cultivation scale, and a clearly cut cinnabar debt fissure tied to the label "修为债 120" with a small "查看依据" affordance. Lower 60% is a pale-jade edged bottom sheet visibly draggable upward with a standard handle. The sheet's top is exactly one dominant Next Quest row with date contract, reward, and clear "完成" button. Beneath it are two compact today-contract rows, one normal and one overdue, plus a persistent recovery entry. Stable four-destination Material navigation remains at bottom and visually separate from the sheet.
Text (verbatim, prioritize these visible strings): "地球 Online"; switcher "地球原生" "修仙" with 修仙 selected; "Lv.23"; "金丹境"; "当前修为 3,420 / 5,000"; "修为债 120"; "查看依据"; "下一项"; "完成本周工作总结"; "截止日期：2026年9月12日"; "+25 修为"; actions "暂缓一天" and "完成"; row "阅读专业书籍"; overdue row "联系一位重要的人" and "已逾期 · 需结算"; "查看恢复路径"; bottom navigation "指挥台" "任务" "角色" "日志".
Style/medium: shippable Android UI mockup, Material 3 bottom-sheet behavior translated into 宗门战况舱; bold but operational, not a poster, dashboard website, or game HUD.
Color palette: near-black jade #071A16, action jade #26C281, rare reward gold #D6A84A, cinnabar red #E5483F, pale text #EAF4EC. The lower sheet stays dark black lacquer with pale-jade edges rather than becoming a white card.
Materials/textures: restrained black lacquer status chamber, one gold realm seal, cinnabar debt fissure, subtle Earth orbit; bottom sheet has tactile jade lip and clean Material spacing. Bold numerals and legible modern Chinese sans, no calligraphy.
Constraints: date-level contracts only; never show a time, countdown, 23:59, streak, ranking, currency, shop, gacha, loot box, AI claim, account/network feature, or fabricated performance metric. Touch targets at least visually 48dp. Debt and overdue state use icon/shape/text as well as color. Exactly one dominant Next Quest. All task names, dates, values, and quantities are synthetic layout examples.
Avoid: fantasy characters, weapons, coins, hands, phone frame, multiple floating cards in the upper status chamber, tiny unreadable text, extra navigation destinations, iOS controls, gradients as decoration, watermark.
